scope: Read-only runtime metadata, source identities and train-calibration scalar status. No model loading, score arrays, raw data, held-out results, training, tests or remote writes.

eta.basis: Latest 72 same-stage updates; subtract log age only with last console line confirmed as that update. One 77.97s endpoint proxy and prior 2.5-4h postprocessing proxy. No new failure or resource wait. Slow20 is a scenario, not a confidence interval or upper bound.
